name: MatCha v1 — Zero-shot
protocol: MatCha v1 fixed 1,500-item full suite, generic zero-shot, direct option only, max 32 new tokens, Table 1 MatCha All. Few-shot, CoT, no-image, and subset columns are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is exact-choice accuracy across all 1,500 MatCha v1 questions in the zero-shot setting.
explanation.zh: 分数是 zero-shot 设置下全部 1,500 道 MatCha v1 题目的选项精确正确率。

summary.en: MatCha evaluates expert materials-characterization image understanding across processing, morphology, structure, and property analysis.
summary.zh: MatCha 评估模型在加工关联、形貌、结构和性能分析中的专家级材料表征图像理解能力。

task_format.en: The model sees a materials-characterization image and expert multiple-choice question, then returns only the option letter.
task_format.zh: 模型会看到材料表征图像和专家级选择题，并只返回选项字母。
